notes.title: UPDATE 1.10
notes.notes:
[p]We received reports about the elevator stopping in Stage 4-4, so we spoke to the building manager and:

[/p][list][*][p] Fixed potential collision bugs with the elevator walls;
[/p][/*][*][p] Prevented an error that could stop enemies from entering the elevator properly;
  [/p][/*][*][p] Added a 60-second timer to make the elevator go up to the next floor even if enemies from the previous floor are still alive — this prevents players from getting stuck there.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Blocking and Parrying[/b] now have a wider angle! You’ll be able to defend against attacks coming from the front and sides — but not from behind. This is a street fight, so always watch your back!

[b]Grabbing enemies[/b] now has greater range. Try tossing them around now!

[b]Enemy voices[/b] have been added — now every enemy has something to say!

Fixed some [b]achievements[/b] that weren’t unlocking correctly.

Fixed a bug that blocked progress if an enemy was killed with a finisher after a successful parry.

With this update, we’ve fixed all major bugs in Reality Rash!

The game has improved a lot in this launch week, and I’m incredibly grateful for all your feedback.

More updates coming soon!!

[/p]

notes.title: Day one update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[p]As promised, the launch patch!!!
[/p][p]We fixed several bugs, most of them possible softlocks that may or may not occur during the game:[/p][p]
Bug that prevented progress on Map 2-5;[/p][p]Bug that made parkour difficult on Map 2-4;[/p][p]Dodge now has a 0.25 second cooldown before being able to roll again;[/p][p]Improved respawn system for when the player falls down a hole (all stages);[/p][p]Improved Elevator on stage 4-4;[/p][p]Improved boss fights. These are just a few examples, among many other improvements.[/p][p]
Use the community to report bugs, the most serious ones can be fixed the same day![/p][p]
Thank you for your patience and trust![/p]

notes.title: Release note...
notes.notes:
Due to a bug that prevented progress from Map 2-5, we reverted to a previous build that is 100% playable from start to finish!

LATER TODAY we will update the game with several fixes and improvements for the gameplay!

Thanks for your patience s2
